recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients to Sell $150 Million in Renewable Diesel Tax Credits
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients agreed to sell about $150 million in production tax credits to a corporate buyer, with credits generated under the Inflation Reduction Act by its Diamond Green Diesel joint venture. Diamond Green Diesel is a 50/50 venture with Valero that can produce more than 1.2 billion gallons of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel a year.
